enchantments.tooltip: Magical Sheltering +33: +33 Enhancement bonus to Magical Resistance Rating
Insightful Seeker +6: Provides a +6 Insight bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +6 Insight bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Quality Combat Mastery +3: +3 Quality bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip, Improved Trip, Sunder, Improved Sunder, Stunning Blow, and Stunning Fist attempts.
Quality Accuracy +4: Passive: +4 Quality bonus to attack rolls
Mythic Belt Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
